rationale: Greek δίσκος 'disc' or αἰγίς 'shield/aegis,' borrowed with vowel-shift. Refers to the celestial disc set upon the shoulder of the Omophoros (cosmic Atlas) — the visible firmament he bears. First of the five things established in the strong bodies of the archons.

Possible Lycopolitan reflex of ϩⲁⲧⲏ 'front, fore-part,' or compound ϩⲁ-ⲣⲁⲧϥ̄ 'at-foot.' Designates a structural feature of the cosmic Pillar — likely its base or foundation. Second item in the archonic-bodies enumeration.

Possibly Greek ἄντλημα 'drawing-vessel, bucket' used metaphorically for body conduits/channels. Paired with ⲙⲟⲟⲙⲉ 'veins' as parallel anatomical terms through which the Living Projection establishes the five things in the strong bodies of the archons. Etymology uncertain.

proposed_english: the molding of the formation of the Gehennas
rationale: Compound: πλάσμα 'thing-molded' + ⲙⲟⲩⲛⲕ 'formation' + Greek γέεννα (pl.) 'Gehennas.' Manichaean cosmological term for the molded fabric of the dark prison-realms — the third of the five things established in the archons' bodies.
Verbal idiom ϯ + ⲍⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲧⲉ ('first one, foremost,' cf. ⲡⲍⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲧ in glossary). 'Make/do first' — used in chapter heading 34 of the Ambassador's first acts in his coming.

Feminine possessive ⲧⲉϩ- ('his') + verbal noun ⲟ̄ⲓ̈ⲛⲉⲓ. Likely related to ⲉⲓ 'come' or ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ 'manifest' — designates the Ambassador's cosmological coming/manifestation in which the ten things are first established. Cf. tentative ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲛⲉ in glossary.

Verb of upward conveyance with 3pl suffix; 'lifts/raises them up to the Aeons of Light.' Synonymous with ⲭⲉⲥⲧϩ̄ in glossary. Preserves soteriological vertical directionality central to Manichaean ascent vocabulary.
